source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 3: The Present Continuous Tense

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ. Tìm vị trí lỗi.

starter.stem: Look! The teacher ___ on the board right now.
starter.explanation_short: right now → Present Continuous: is writing.
starter.explanation_long: 'Right now' = đang xảy ra lúc nói → is/am/are + V-ing. 'Write' và 'writes' là Simple Present — dùng cho thói quen.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ right now = đang xảy ra → is writing
starter.feedback_wrong: right now → Present Continuous: is + writing
starter.ielts_tip: Từ tín hiệu Continuous: now, right now, at the moment, currently, look!, listen!
starter.distractor_note: obvious: write, writes (Simple Present), was writing (past)

starter.stem: Students ___ for their IELTS exam this week.
starter.explanation_short: Students = số nhiều + this week → are preparing.
starter.explanation_long: Students = they = số nhiều → are (không is). this week = giai đoạn hiện tại → V-ing: preparing.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Students = số nhiều + this week → are preparing
starter.feedback_wrong: Students = số nhiều → are (không is). Thêm -ing: preparing
starter.ielts_tip: Students/They/We/You + are + V-ing. He/She/It + is + V-ing.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: prepare (no be), are prepare (no -ing), is preparing (wrong be)

starter.stem: She ___ the importance of grammar for IELTS.
starter.explanation_short: understand = stative verb → Simple Present: understands.
starter.explanation_long: 'Understand' là stative verb → không dùng -ing. she = ngôi 3 số ít → understands.
starter.feedback_wrong: understand = stative → không dùng is understanding. she → understands
starter.distractor_note: obvious: is understanding, understand (no -s), are understanding

starter.stem: I ___ my IELTS exam next Saturday — I already registered.
starter.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp sẵn → am taking (Present Continuous for future).
starter.explanation_long: Present Continuous dùng cho kế hoạch tương lai gần ĐÃ được sắp xếp. 'Already registered' xác nhận điều này. 'Will take' = quyết định lúc nói.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 Kế hoạch đã đăng ký → am taking
starter.feedback_wrong: Kế hoạch đã có sẵn → Present Continuous: am taking (không will take)
starter.ielts_tip: Part 1: 'I'm meeting/seeing/going...' = kế hoạch đã có. 'I'll...' = quyết định ngay lúc nói.

starter.stem: More and more students ___ online courses these days.
starter.explanation_short: these days + xu hướng đang thay đổi → are taking.
starter.explanation_long: 'These days' + xu hướng đang tăng → Present Continuous. 'More and more' xác nhận đây là xu hướng đang diễn ra.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ these days + xu hướng → are taking
starter.feedback_wrong: these days + more and more = xu hướng đang thay đổi → are taking
starter.ielts_tip: Task 2: 'More and more people are choosing/using/relying on...' → xu hướng → Continuous.

starter.stem: He ___ attention in class right now.
starter.explanation_long: Phủ định Present Continuous: is/am/are + not + V-ing. 'He' → isn't paying. 'Doesn't paying' sai cả auxiliary lẫn -ing.
starter.feedback_wrong: Phủ định Continuous: isn't + V-ing (không doesn't + V-ing)
starter.ielts_tip: Phủ định: Simple → doesn't/don't + V. Continuous → isn't/aren't + V-ing.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: doesn't paying, isn't pay (no -ing), not paying (no be)

starter.explanation_short: class = số ít + at the moment → is running. run → running (double n).
starter.explanation_long: 'At the moment' → Continuous. 'class' = số ít → is. run: kết thúc CVC (consonant-vowel-consonant) → double n: running.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ class = số ít + at the moment → is running
starter.feedback_wrong: run → running (nhân đôi n). class = số ít → is running
starter.ielts_tip: CVC rule: run→running, sit→sitting, get→getting. Không nhân đôi: read→reading, study→studying.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: is runing (spelling), are running (wrong be), runs (Simple)

starter.stem: She usually ___ notes in class, but today she ___ on her laptop.
starter.explanation_short: usually = thói quen → takes. today + đang xảy ra → is typing.
starter.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'usually' = thói quen → Simple Present: takes. Lớp 2: 'today' + hành động đang xảy ra khác bình thường → Continuous: is typing.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 usually → takes | today = đang xảy ra → is typing
starter.feedback_wrong: usually → Simple Present (takes). today + đang xảy ra → Continuous (is typing).
starter.ielts_tip: Câu có hai vế: vế thói quen → Simple | vế đang xảy ra → Continuous. Hai thì trong 1 câu = grammatical range!
starter.distractor_note: plausible: takes/types nghe đúng nhưng bỏ qua 'today' signal

starter.stem: ___ the teacher ___ online classes this term?
starter.explanation_short: the teacher = ngôi 3 số ít → Is teaching?
starter.explanation_long: Câu hỏi Continuous: Is/Am/Are + S + V-ing? 'The teacher' = ngôi 3 số ít → Is teaching.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ the teacher = số ít → Is + teaching?
starter.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi Continuous: Is + S + V-ing. teacher = số ít → Is teaching
starter.ielts_tip: Hỏi về đang xảy ra: Is/Are + S + V-ing? Hỏi về thói quen: Does/Do + S + V?

starter.stem: Education systems around the world ___ rapidly due to technology.
starter.explanation_short: xu hướng đang thay đổi nhanh → are changing.
starter.explanation_long: 'Rapidly' + bối cảnh thay đổi do technology → xu hướng đang diễn ra → Present Continuous. 'Education systems' = số nhiều → are.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 xu hướng nhanh + technology → are changing
starter.feedback_wrong: xu hướng đang diễn ra → Present Continuous: are changing
starter.ielts_tip: Task 2: 'Education systems are changing/evolving/adapting due to...' → xu hướng → Continuous.

build_up.stem: My professor usually ___ very clearly, but today she ___ too fast for students to follow.
build_up.explanation_short: usually → explains. today + khác bình thường → is speaking.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Usually' = thói quen → Simple: explains. 'Today' + 'too fast' = hành động tạm thời khác thường → Continuous: is speaking.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 usually → explains | today (different from usual) → is speaking
build_up.feedback_wrong: usually → Simple. today + khác bình thường → Continuous.
build_up.ielts_tip: Khi câu có 'usually...but today/this week' → hai thì khác nhau = Grammatical Range.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: explains/speaks nghe đúng nhưng bỏ 'today' signal

build_up.stem: Although many students ___ online learning is convenient, they ___ the lack of face-to-face interaction.
build_up.explanation_short: think (ý kiến) + mind (không thích) = cả hai stative → Simple Present.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Think' khi nêu ý kiến = stative → think. 'Mind' (= phàn nàn về) = stative → mind. Cả hai không dùng -ing.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ think (ý kiến) + mind (cảm xúc) = cả hai stative → Simple
build_up.feedback_wrong: think (ý kiến) và mind (cảm xúc phàn nàn) = stative verbs → không dùng -ing.
build_up.ielts_tip: Stative verbs thường gặp: think, believe, mind, prefer, wish, suppose, doubt.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: are thinking nghe natural trong một số ngữ cảnh

build_up.stem: The number of students ___ to study abroad ___ significantly this year.
build_up.explanation_short: who choose (students số nhiều). The number of = số ít → is increasing (xu hướng năm nay).
build_up.explanation_long: 'Who choose' vì who = students (số nhiều). 'The number of' = số ít → is increasing. 'This year' + xu hướng → Continuous.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 who + students → choose | The number of = số ít + this year → is increasing
build_up.feedback_wrong: who = students (số nhiều) → choose. The number of = số ít + xu hướng → is increasing.
build_up.ielts_tip: The number of + V số ít. A number of + V số nhiều. Phân biệt rõ khi dùng trong Task 2.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: who choose/increases — dễ nhầm The number of là số nhiều

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Universities increasingly offering online degrees to meet the growing demand from working professionals.'
options: increasingly offering → are increasingly offering (thiếu be)
build_up.correct_answer: increasingly offering → are increasingly offering (thiếu be)
build_up.explanation_short: Thiếu 'are' trước offering: are increasingly offering.
build_up.explanation_long: Present Continuous = be + V-ing. 'Universities offering' thiếu 'are'. Câu đúng: 'Universities are increasingly offering online degrees...'
build_up.feedback_wrong: Cấu trúc Continuous bắt buộc: be + V-ing. Không thể bỏ 'are'.
build_up.ielts_tip: Lỗi hay gặp trong Writing: bỏ 'are' trước V-ing → câu sai hoàn toàn.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: 'Universities' trông như số ít → University. 'Growing' trông như cần sửa.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'I am currently wanting to improve my IELTS score because I am knowing my grammar needs more work.'
options: am wanting → want | am knowing → know
build_up.correct_answer: am wanting → want | am knowing → know
build_up.explanation_short: want + know = stative verbs → không dùng -ing.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Want' và 'know' là stative verbs → Simple Present: want, know. 'Currently' không thay đổi quy tắc với stative verbs.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 want + know = stative → Simple Present. Currently không giúp được!
build_up.feedback_wrong: want và know là stative → không bao giờ dùng -ing dù có 'currently'.
build_up.ielts_tip: 'Currently' không biến stative thành Continuous. I currently know/want/understand... (Simple Present).
build_up.distractor_note: bẫy: 'currently' gợi ý Continuous, dẫn đến nghĩ chỉ 1 lỗi

build_up.stem: Speaking Part 1: 'What are your plans for this weekend?' → Câu trả lời nào chuẩn?
options: I will study for my IELTS exam because I registered last month.
I am studying for my IELTS exam this weekend — I've already planned my schedule.
I study for my IELTS exam this weekend.
I would study for my IELTS exam this weekend.
build_up.correct_answer: I am studying for my IELTS exam this weekend — I've already planned my schedule.
build_up.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp → am studying (Present Continuous for future).
build_up.explanation_long: 'Already planned' = kế hoạch có sẵn → Present Continuous. 'Will study' = quyết định lúc nói (không có dấu hiệu đã lên kế hoạch).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 Kế hoạch đã có + already planned → am studying
build_up.feedback_wrong: Kế hoạch đã lên trước → Present Continuous, không phải will.
build_up.ielts_tip: Part 1 plans: 'I'm meeting/visiting/travelling...' (arranged) vs 'I'll probably...' (not sure yet).
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: will study nghe tự nhiên và rất phổ biến

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Many educators are believing that traditional exams are failing to measure true academic ability.'
options: Many educators → Most educators (số chính xác hơn)
build_up.explanation_short: believe = stative verb → believe (không are believing).
build_up.explanation_long: 'Believe' là stative verb khi nêu ý kiến → believe. 'Are failing' đúng vì 'fail' ở đây là action verb (đang không đạt được). 'Are failing to measure' = đang thất bại trong việc đo lường → Continuous hợp lý.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ believe = stative → believe. Nhưng 'are failing' đúng vì fail = action ở đây!
build_up.feedback_wrong: believe (ý kiến) = stative → không dùng -ing. 'are failing' đúng (fail = action verb trong ngữ cảnh này).
build_up.ielts_tip: Phân biệt: believe (ý kiến) = stative. fail (action = không làm được) = có thể dùng Continuous.
build_up.distractor_note: bẫy tinh tế: are failing cũng trông như lỗi nhưng thực ra đúng

build_up.stem: Task 2 — Câu nào CHUẨN nhất để mở bài về xu hướng giáo dục?
options: Technology changes the way students learn in recent years.
Technology is changing the way students learn in recent years.
Technology changed the way students learn in recent years.
Technology has changed the way students learn in recent years.
build_up.correct_answer: Technology is changing the way students learn in recent years.
build_up.explanation_short: in recent years + xu hướng đang diễn ra → is changing.
build_up.explanation_long: 'In recent years' kết hợp với xu hướng đang diễn ra → Present Continuous 'is changing'. 'Has changed' (Present Perfect) cũng đúng nhưng nhấn mạnh kết quả. 'Is changing' nhấn mạnh quá trình đang diễn ra → phù hợp hơn cho mở bài về xu hướng.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 in recent years + xu hướng đang diễn ra → is changing
build_up.feedback_wrong: in recent years + đang xảy ra → Present Continuous: is changing.
build_up.ielts_tip: Mở bài Task 2: 'Technology is changing/reshaping/transforming...' → xu hướng đang diễn ra. Band 6.0+.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: has changed cũng hợp lý nhưng nhấn mạnh kết quả hơn xu hướng

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The number of universities that offer distance learning are growing rapidly as technology improves.'
options: that offer → that offers (relative clause agreement)
are growing → is growing (The number of = số ít)
build_up.correct_answer: are growing → is growing (The number of = số ít)
build_up.explanation_short: The number of = số ít → is growing (không are growing).
build_up.explanation_long: 'The number of universities' = chủ ngữ. Động từ chia theo 'The number' (số ít) → is growing. 'That offer' đúng vì who = universities (số nhiều). 'technology improves' đúng (sự thật chung).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 The number of = số ít → is growing. 'that offer' đúng (universities số nhiều)!
build_up.feedback_wrong: The number of = số ít → is growing. Không phải are growing dù 'universities' là số nhiều.
build_up.ielts_tip: The number of + noun + is (singular). A number of + noun + are (plural). Luôn nhớ quy tắc này trong Task 2.
build_up.distractor_note: bẫy: 'that offer' trông sai (offer không có -s); technology improves trông như lỗi

build_up.stem: Tìm câu ĐÚNG hoàn toàn cho IELTS Speaking Part 1:
options: I am usually studying in the library because I am finding it easier to concentrate there.
I usually study in the library because I find it easier to concentrate there.
I usually am studying in the library because I find it easier to concentrate there.
I usually study in the library because I am finding it easier to concentrate there.
build_up.correct_answer: I usually study in the library because I find it easier to concentrate there.
build_up.explanation_short: usually → study (thói quen). find = stative → find (Simple).
build_up.explanation_long: 'Usually' = thói quen → Simple: study. 'Find it easier' = stative (cảm nhận/nhận thức) → Simple: find. Cả hai vế đều cần Simple Present.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🏆 usually → study | find (stative) → find. Cả hai Simple Present!
build_up.feedback_wrong: usually → Simple Present. find (= nhận thấy) là stative → Simple Present: find.
build_up.ielts_tip: 'Find it + adj' = stative → Simple. 'I find it helpful/useful/interesting...' → không am finding.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: am finding nghe tự nhiên; usually am studying trông như đúng

layers: think = stative for opinion vs dynamic for active thinking
challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'I am currently thinking that the education system is failing students, while my professor is thinking about new assessment methods.'
options: am currently thinking that (ý kiến — nên dùng Simple)
my professor is thinking about (hành động đang xảy ra — đúng)
challenge.correct_answer: am currently thinking that (ý kiến — nên dùng Simple)
challenge.explanation_short: think (ý kiến) → Simple: I think. think about (đang cân nhắc) → Continuous: is thinking about.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'I am thinking that' = nêu ý kiến = stative → 'I think that'. Lớp 2: 'my professor is thinking about new methods' = đang cân nhắc = dynamic → 'is thinking about' đúng. Lớp 3: Cùng động từ 'think' nhưng ngữ nghĩa khác → thì khác nhau. Đây là phân biệt nâng cao nhất của stative vs dynamic.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 think (ý kiến) → Simple. think about (đang cân nhắc) → Continuous. Cùng verb, khác nghĩa!
challenge.feedback_wrong: 'I think that' (ý kiến) = stative → Simple. 'is thinking about' (đang cân nhắc) = dynamic → Continuous đúng.
challenge.ielts_tip: think THAT (= believe) → Simple. think ABOUT (= consider) → có thể Continuous. Phân biệt bởi preposition.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (cả hai sai) bẫy người nhận ra [A] nhưng không biết [C] đúng.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The teaching staff, who is responsible for curriculum development, are currently reviewing the assessment criteria.'
options: The teaching staff, who is responsible
who is responsible for curriculum development
are currently reviewing the assessment criteria
challenge.correct_answer: The teaching staff, who is responsible
challenge.explanation_short: who = teaching staff (collective → singular) → who is đúng. Nhưng 'teaching staff are' cũng đúng (collective có thể số nhiều).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Teaching staff' = collective noun → trong British English có thể là số nhiều (are) hoặc số ít (is). Lớp 2: Nếu 'staff are' (số nhiều), thì 'who is' phải đổi thành 'who are' để nhất quán. Inconsistency: staff (số nhiều) + who is (số ít) = mâu thuẫn. Lớp 3: Câu đúng: 'staff who ARE responsible...are reviewing' hoặc 'staff which IS responsible...is reviewing'.
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ Mâu thuẫn: 'staff are' (số nhiều) nhưng 'who is' (số ít). Phải nhất quán!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Inconsistency: nếu staff = số nhiều (are) thì who cũng phải là số nhiều (who are). 'Who is' mâu thuẫn với 'staff are'.
challenge.ielts_tip: Collective nouns (staff/team/committee): chọn số ít hoặc số nhiều rồi giữ NHẤT QUÁN xuyên suốt câu.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (Không có lỗi) bẫy người không để ý inconsistency giữa 'are' và 'who is'.

challenge.stem: Câu mở bài Task 2 nào thể hiện Grammatical Range CAO NHẤT?
options: Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning becomes increasingly popular.
Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
Education is playing a crucial role in society, and online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning has become increasingly popular.
challenge.correct_answer: Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
challenge.explanation_short: plays (sự thật) + is becoming (xu hướng đang diễn ra) = hai thì khác nhau = Grammatical Range cao.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Education plays' = sự thật bất biến → Simple Present đúng. Lớp 2: 'online learning is becoming' = xu hướng đang diễn ra → Continuous đúng. Lớp 3: Kết hợp hai thì khác nhau vì ngữ nghĩa khác nhau = Grammatical Range band 6.5+. Option C dùng 'is playing' sai vì education playing a role = sự thật ổn định, không phải xu hướng đang thay đổi.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 plays (sự thật ổn định) + is becoming (xu hướng) = Grammatical Range band 6.5+!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Kết hợp Simple (sự thật) + Continuous (xu hướng) trong 1 câu = đỉnh cao Grammatical Range Task 2.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2 nâng cao: dùng hai thì khác nhau trong 1 câu khi ngữ nghĩa thật sự khác nhau. Không trộn tùy tiện.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C gần đúng nhưng 'is playing' sai. Option D (has become) đúng ngữ pháp nhưng nhấn mạnh kết quả, không phải xu hướng đang diễn ra.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'I will present my research findings next week because I have been preparing for months and my supervisor is expecting me to.'
options: I will present my research findings
because I have been preparing for months
my supervisor is expecting me to
Không có lỗi — will và is expecting đều đúng
challenge.correct_answer: I will present my research findings
challenge.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp lâu dài → I am presenting (không will present).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Have been preparing for months' và 'supervisor is expecting' = dấu hiệu rõ ràng đây là kế hoạch đã được sắp xếp từ trước → Present Continuous: 'I am presenting next week'. Lớp 2: 'Will' = quyết định lúc nói, không phù hợp khi đã chuẩn bị từ lâu. Lớp 3: 'My supervisor is expecting' đúng (kỳ vọng = dynamic expectation đang diễn ra).
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ Chuẩn bị từ lâu → kế hoạch đã có → I am presenting (không will present)!
challenge.feedback_wrong: 'Have been preparing for months' = đã lên kế hoạch từ trước → Present Continuous cho future: I am presenting.
challenge.ielts_tip: Dấu hiệu kế hoạch có sẵn: have been preparing/already booked/already registered → Continuous. Will = quyết định ngay lúc nói.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (Không có lỗi) bẫy vì 'will present' nghe rất tự nhiên và phổ biến.

layers: appear = stative (seem) vs appear = dynamic (come on stage)
challenge.stem:
Câu Task 2 sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The results are appearing to suggest that blended learning, which is seeming more effective than traditional methods, is gaining wider acceptance.'
challenge.explanation_short: appear (= seem) + seem = stative → Simple: appears to suggest, seems more effective.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'appear to suggest' = stative (= seem to) → Simple: 'appears to suggest'. Lớp 2: 'seem' = luôn stative → Simple: 'seems more effective' (không 'is seeming'). Lớp 3: 'is gaining' đúng vì 'gain wider acceptance' = xu hướng đang diễn ra = dynamic. Hai lỗi stative, một Continuous đúng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 appears to suggest (stative) + seems (stative) = cả hai Simple. is gaining (dynamic trend) = Continuous đúng!
challenge.feedback_wrong: appear (= seem) và seem = luôn stative → Simple. is gaining (xu hướng) = dynamic → Continuous đúng.
challenge.ielts_tip: appear to + V (= seem to) = stative → Simple. Nhưng appear on stage (xuất hiện) = dynamic → có thể Continuous.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A hoặc B riêng lẻ đều bẫy. Cần nhận ra cả hai đều sai.

layers: Simple vs Continuous for academic stance
challenge.stem: Câu nào CHUẨN NHẤT để trích dẫn nghiên cứu trong IELTS Task 2 body paragraph?
options: Research is consistently finding that students who sleep well are performing significantly better academically.
Research consistently finds that students who sleep well perform significantly better academically.
Research consistently finds that students who sleep well are performing significantly better academically.
Research is consistently finding that students who sleep well perform significantly better academically.
challenge.correct_answer: Research consistently finds that students who sleep well perform significantly better academically.
challenge.explanation_short: finds (sự thật nghiên cứu) + perform (kết quả như quy luật) = cả hai Simple.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Research finds' = reporting verb cho kết quả nghiên cứu đã được thiết lập → Simple Present. Lớp 2: 'perform better' = kết quả như quy luật → Simple Present. Lớp 3: Option C gần đúng nhưng 'are performing' làm giảm tính academic — ngụ ý xu hướng tạm thời thay vì quy luật đã xác lập.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Research finds (xác lập) + perform (quy luật) = hai Simple Present. Academic nhất!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Research finds (sự thật xác lập) + perform (quy luật) = Simple Present. Tránh Continuous cho kết quả nghiên cứu đã xác lập.
challenge.ielts_tip: Academic reporting: 'Research shows/finds/suggests/indicates that + Simple Present' = kết quả như quy luật. Continuous nghe kém academic hơn.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C rất gần — chỉ khác perform/are performing. Đây là bẫy tinh tế nhất.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The university is being expanding its online programme, which is being increasingly popular among working adults.'
options: is being expanding its online programme
challenge.explanation_short: is being expanding sai (là Continuous Passive không đúng). is being popular sai (popular = adj, không cần being).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Is being expanding' = cố gắng dùng Continuous Passive nhưng sai — 'is expanding' là đúng (Active Continuous). Lớp 2: 'is being increasingly popular' sai — 'popular' là tính từ, dùng với be đơn giản: 'is becoming increasingly popular'. 'Is being popular' không tồn tại trong tiếng Anh chuẩn. Lớp 3: Cả hai lỗi liên quan đến misuse của 'being'.
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ is expanding (không is being expanding) + is becoming popular (không is being popular). 'Being' bị dùng sai cả hai chỗ!
challenge.feedback_wrong: is expanding (Active Continuous, không cần 'being'). is becoming popular (không 'is being popular' — popular là adj).
challenge.ielts_tip: Continuous Active: is + V-ing (is expanding). Continuous Passive: is being + V3 (is being expanded). 'Is being popular' không tồn tại.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'is being' trông như Continuous Passive đúng — đây là bẫy về passive vs active.

layers: two independent clauses with different temporal aspects
challenge.stem: Câu Task 2 nào dùng SONG SONG hai thì đúng nhất về mặt nghĩa?
options: Traditional universities maintain their prestige, but online platforms are disrupting the educational landscape.
Traditional universities are maintaining their prestige, but online platforms are disrupting the educational landscape.
Traditional universities maintain their prestige, but online platforms disrupt the educational landscape.
Traditional universities are maintaining their prestige, but online platforms disrupt the educational landscape.
challenge.correct_answer: Traditional universities maintain their prestige, but online platforms are disrupting the educational landscape.
challenge.explanation_short: maintain (sự thật ổn định) + are disrupting (xu hướng đang diễn ra mạnh).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Traditional universities maintain prestige' = thực tế ổn định, bền vững → Simple. Lớp 2: 'online platforms are disrupting' = xu hướng đang xảy ra, tác động ngay lúc này → Continuous. Lớp 3: Hai thì khác nhau vì hai tình huống có bản chất thời gian khác nhau — đây là sử dụng ngữ pháp có chủ đích, không phải ngẫu nhiên = band 6.5+.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 maintain (ổn định bền vững) + are disrupting (đang xảy ra mạnh mẽ) = Grammatical Range cao nhất!
challenge.feedback_wrong: maintain = sự thật ổn định → Simple. are disrupting = xu hướng tác động mạnh đang diễn ra → Continuous.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2 đẳng cấp: dùng hai thì có chủ đích dựa trên nghĩa, không phải dùng cùng thì cho 'đối xứng'. Giám khảo nhận ra ngay.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (cả hai Continuous) trông đối xứng — nhưng 'are maintaining prestige' kém academic hơn 'maintain'.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The curriculum, which is containing outdated content, is having a negative impact on students who are possessing strong critical thinking skills.'
options: students who are possessing strong critical thinking skills
challenge.explanation_short: contain (luôn stative) → contains. possess (stative) → possess. have a negative impact = dynamic → is having đúng.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'contain' = luôn stative → 'contains' (không is containing). Lớp 2: 'have a negative impact' = idiom diễn tả tác động đang xảy ra = dynamic → 'is having' đúng. Lớp 3: 'possess' = stative (sở hữu thuộc tính) → 'possess' (không are possessing). Ba động từ, ba quyết định khác nhau.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 contains (stative) + is having (dynamic idiom) + possess (stative). Ba động từ, ba quyết định!
challenge.feedback_wrong: contain = stative → contains. have a negative impact = dynamic → is having đúng. possess (sở hữu) = stative → possess.
challenge.ielts_tip: have = stative khi nghĩa là 'có/sở hữu'. have = dynamic khi trong idiom: have a meeting/impact/look → có thể Continuous.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C sai. Option A sai. Nhưng cần nhận ra [B] đúng để chọn D — bẫy 3 lớp.

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi?
'I am believing that the number of students who are preferring online education are growing, which is suggesting a fundamental shift in how society is seeing the value of traditional schooling.'
options: 3 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing
4 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing + is suggesting
5 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing + is suggesting + is seeing
challenge.correct_answer: 4 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing + is suggesting
challenge.explanation_short: believe/prefer/suggest = stative → Simple. The number of = singular → is growing. seeing (nhận thức) có thể stative nhưng ngữ cảnh cho phép.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'believe' = stative → 'I believe'. Lớp 2: 'prefer' = stative → 'who prefer'. Lớp 3: 'The number of students' = singular → 'is growing' (không 'are growing'). Lớp 4: 'suggest' khi dùng như reporting verb về xu hướng = stative-like → 'suggests'. Lớp 5: 'is seeing the value' — 'see' (nhận thức/nhìn nhận) = stative trong ngữ cảnh này, nhưng 'is seeing' có thể chấp nhận được trong một số quan điểm → không tính là lỗi chắc chắn. Vậy 4 lỗi rõ ràng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! 4 lỗi: believe→believe | prefer→prefer | are growing→is growing | suggesting→suggests. is seeing có thể tranh luận.
challenge.feedback_wrong: believe (stative) + prefer (stative) + The number of (singular) + suggest (stative reporting verb) = 4 lỗi rõ ràng. 'is seeing' có thể tranh luận.
challenge.ielts_tip: Khi review: check stative verbs (believe/prefer/suggest) + The number of (singular) trước. Đây là 4 lỗi phổ biến nhất ở band 5.5→6.5.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (5 lỗi) bẫy mạnh vì 'is seeing' trông sai. Option B (3 lỗi) bẫy người bỏ sót 'are growing'. Cần phân tích đủ 4 điểm.

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Starter
ui.description: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

items.stem: Look! The teacher ___ on the board right now.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ right now = đang xảy ra → is writing
items.feedback_wrong: right now → Present Continuous: is + writing
items.explanation_short: right now → Present Continuous: is writing.
items.ielts_tip: Từ tín hiệu Continuous: now, right now, at the moment, currently, look!, listen!

items.stem: Students ___ for their IELTS exam this week.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Students = số nhiều + this week → are preparing
items.feedback_wrong: Students = số nhiều → are (không is). Thêm -ing: preparing
items.explanation_short: Students = số nhiều + this week → are preparing.
items.ielts_tip: Students/They/We/You + are + V-ing. He/She/It + is + V-ing.

items.stem: She ___ the importance of grammar for IELTS.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ understand = stative verb → understands
items.feedback_wrong: understand = stative → không dùng is understanding. she → understands
items.explanation_short: understand = stative verb → Simple Present: understands.
items.ielts_tip: understand/know/believe/want/need → không bao giờ dùng -ing.

items.stem: I ___ my IELTS exam next Saturday — I already registered.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 Kế hoạch đã đăng ký → am taking
items.feedback_wrong: Kế hoạch đã có sẵn → Present Continuous: am taking (không will take)
items.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp sẵn → am taking (Present Continuous for future).
items.ielts_tip: Part 1: 'I'm meeting/seeing/going...' = kế hoạch đã có. 'I'll...' = quyết định ngay lúc nói.

items.stem: More and more students ___ online courses these days.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ these days + xu hướng → are taking
items.feedback_wrong: these days + more and more = xu hướng đang thay đổi → are taking
items.explanation_short: these days + xu hướng đang thay đổi → are taking.
items.ielts_tip: Task 2: 'More and more people are choosing/using/relying on...' → xu hướng → Continuous.

items.stem: He ___ attention in class right now.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Phủ định Continuous: isn't + paying
items.feedback_wrong: Phủ định Continuous: isn't + V-ing (không doesn't + V-ing)
items.explanation_short: Phủ định Continuous: isn't + V-ing.
items.ielts_tip: Phủ định: Simple → doesn't/don't + V. Continuous → isn't/aren't + V-ing.

items.stem: The class ___ at the moment.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ class = số ít + at the moment → is running
items.feedback_wrong: run → running (nhân đôi n). class = số ít → is running
items.explanation_short: class = số ít + at the moment → is running. run → running (double n).
items.ielts_tip: CVC rule: run→running, sit→sitting, get→getting. Không nhân đôi: read→reading, study→studying.

items.stem: She usually ___ notes in class, but today she ___ on her laptop.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 usually → takes | today = đang xảy ra → is typing
items.feedback_wrong: usually → Simple Present (takes). today + đang xảy ra → Continuous (is typing).
items.explanation_short: usually = thói quen → takes. today + đang xảy ra → is typing.
items.ielts_tip: Câu có hai vế: vế thói quen → Simple | vế đang xảy ra → Continuous. Hai thì trong 1 câu = grammatical range!

items.stem: ___ the teacher ___ online classes this term?
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ the teacher = số ít → Is + teaching?
items.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi Continuous: Is + S + V-ing. teacher = số ít → Is teaching
items.explanation_short: the teacher = ngôi 3 số ít → Is teaching?
items.ielts_tip: Hỏi về đang xảy ra: Is/Are + S + V-ing? Hỏi về thói quen: Does/Do + S + V?

items.stem: Education systems around the world ___ rapidly due to technology.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 xu hướng nhanh + technology → are changing
items.feedback_wrong: xu hướng đang diễn ra → Present Continuous: are changing
items.explanation_short: xu hướng đang thay đổi nhanh → are changing.
items.ielts_tip: Task 2: 'Education systems are changing/evolving/adapting due to...' → xu hướng → Continuous.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Build Up
ui.description: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

items.stem: My professor usually ___ very clearly, but today she ___ too fast for students to follow.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 usually → explains | today (different from usual) → is speaking
items.feedback_wrong: usually → Simple. today + khác bình thường → Continuous.
items.explanation_short: usually → explains. today + khác bình thường → is speaking.
items.ielts_tip: Khi câu có 'usually...but today/this week' → hai thì khác nhau = Grammatical Range.

items.stem: Although many students ___ online learning is convenient, they ___ the lack of face-to-face interaction.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ think (ý kiến) + mind (cảm xúc) = cả hai stative → Simple
items.feedback_wrong: think (ý kiến) và mind (cảm xúc phàn nàn) = stative verbs → không dùng -ing.
items.explanation_short: think (ý kiến) + mind (không thích) = cả hai stative → Simple Present.
items.ielts_tip: Stative verbs thường gặp: think, believe, mind, prefer, wish, suppose, doubt.

items.stem: The number of students ___ to study abroad ___ significantly this year.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 who + students → choose | The number of = số ít + this year → is increasing
items.feedback_wrong: who = students (số nhiều) → choose. The number of = số ít + xu hướng → is increasing.
items.explanation_short: who choose (students số nhiều). The number of = số ít → is increasing (xu hướng năm nay).
items.ielts_tip: The number of + V số ít. A number of + V số nhiều. Phân biệt rõ khi dùng trong Task 2.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Universities increasingly offering online degrees to meet the growing demand from working professionals.'
options: increasingly offering → are increasingly offering (thiếu be)
items.correct_answer: increasingly offering → are increasingly offering (thiếu be)
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Thiếu 'are': Universities are increasingly offering...
items.feedback_wrong: Cấu trúc Continuous bắt buộc: be + V-ing. Không thể bỏ 'are'.
items.explanation_short: Thiếu 'are' trước offering: are increasingly offering.
items.ielts_tip: Lỗi hay gặp trong Writing: bỏ 'are' trước V-ing → câu sai hoàn toàn.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'I am currently wanting to improve my IELTS score because I am knowing my grammar needs more work.'
options: am wanting → want | am knowing → know
items.correct_answer: am wanting → want | am knowing → know
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 want + know = stative → Simple Present. Currently không giúp được!
items.feedback_wrong: want và know là stative → không bao giờ dùng -ing dù có 'currently'.
items.explanation_short: want + know = stative verbs → không dùng -ing.
items.ielts_tip: 'Currently' không biến stative thành Continuous. I currently know/want/understand... (Simple Present).

items.stem: Speaking Part 1: 'What are your plans for this weekend?' → Câu trả lời nào chuẩn?
options: I will study for my IELTS exam because I registered last month.
I am studying for my IELTS exam this weekend — I've already planned my schedule.
I study for my IELTS exam this weekend.
I would study for my IELTS exam this weekend.
items.correct_answer: I am studying for my IELTS exam this weekend — I've already planned my schedule.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 Kế hoạch đã có + already planned → am studying
items.feedback_wrong: Kế hoạch đã lên trước → Present Continuous, không phải will.
items.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp → am studying (Present Continuous for future).
items.ielts_tip: Part 1 plans: 'I'm meeting/visiting/travelling...' (arranged) vs 'I'll probably...' (not sure yet).

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Many educators are believing that traditional exams are failing to measure true academic ability.'
options: Many educators → Most educators (số chính xác hơn)
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ believe = stative → believe. Nhưng 'are failing' đúng vì fail = action ở đây!
items.feedback_wrong: believe (ý kiến) = stative → không dùng -ing. 'are failing' đúng (fail = action verb trong ngữ cảnh này).
items.explanation_short: believe = stative verb → believe (không are believing).
items.ielts_tip: Phân biệt: believe (ý kiến) = stative. fail (action = không làm được) = có thể dùng Continuous.

items.stem: Task 2 — Câu nào CHUẨN nhất để mở bài về xu hướng giáo dục?
options: Technology changes the way students learn in recent years.
Technology is changing the way students learn in recent years.
Technology changed the way students learn in recent years.
Technology has changed the way students learn in recent years.
items.correct_answer: Technology is changing the way students learn in recent years.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 in recent years + xu hướng đang diễn ra → is changing
items.feedback_wrong: in recent years + đang xảy ra → Present Continuous: is changing.
items.explanation_short: in recent years + xu hướng đang diễn ra → is changing.
items.ielts_tip: Mở bài Task 2: 'Technology is changing/reshaping/transforming...' → xu hướng đang diễn ra. Band 6.0+.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The number of universities that offer distance learning are growing rapidly as technology improves.'
options: that offer → that offers (relative clause agreement)
are growing → is growing (The number of = số ít)
items.correct_answer: are growing → is growing (The number of = số ít)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 The number of = số ít → is growing. 'that offer' đúng (universities số nhiều)!
items.feedback_wrong: The number of = số ít → is growing. Không phải are growing dù 'universities' là số nhiều.
items.explanation_short: The number of = số ít → is growing (không are growing).
items.ielts_tip: The number of + noun + is (singular). A number of + noun + are (plural). Luôn nhớ quy tắc này trong Task 2.

items.stem: Tìm câu ĐÚNG hoàn toàn cho IELTS Speaking Part 1:
options: I am usually studying in the library because I am finding it easier to concentrate there.
I usually study in the library because I find it easier to concentrate there.
I usually am studying in the library because I find it easier to concentrate there.
I usually study in the library because I am finding it easier to concentrate there.
items.correct_answer: I usually study in the library because I find it easier to concentrate there.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 usually → study | find (stative) → find. Cả hai Simple Present!
items.feedback_wrong: usually → Simple Present. find (= nhận thấy) là stative → Simple Present: find.
items.explanation_short: usually → study (thói quen). find = stative → find (Simple).
items.ielts_tip: 'Find it + adj' = stative → Simple. 'I find it helpful/useful/interesting...' → không am finding.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Challenge
ui.description: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ. Tìm vị trí lỗi.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'I am currently thinking that the education system is failing students, while my professor is thinking about new assessment methods.'
options: am currently thinking that (ý kiến — nên dùng Simple)
my professor is thinking about (hành động đang xảy ra — đúng)
items.correct_answer: am currently thinking that (ý kiến — nên dùng Simple)
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 think (ý kiến) → Simple. think about (đang cân nhắc) → Continuous. Cùng verb, khác nghĩa!
items.feedback_wrong: 'I think that' (ý kiến) = stative → Simple. 'is thinking about' (đang cân nhắc) = dynamic → Continuous đúng.
items.explanation_short: think (ý kiến) → Simple: I think. think about (đang cân nhắc) → Continuous: is thinking about.
items.ielts_tip: think THAT (= believe) → Simple. think ABOUT (= consider) → có thể Continuous. Phân biệt bởi preposition.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The teaching staff, who is responsible for curriculum development, are currently reviewing the assessment criteria.'
options: The teaching staff, who is responsible
who is responsible for curriculum development
are currently reviewing the assessment criteria
items.correct_answer: The teaching staff, who is responsible
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Mâu thuẫn: 'staff are' (số nhiều) nhưng 'who is' (số ít). Phải nhất quán!
items.feedback_wrong: Inconsistency: nếu staff = số nhiều (are) thì who cũng phải là số nhiều (who are). 'Who is' mâu thuẫn với 'staff are'.
items.explanation_short: who = teaching staff (collective → singular) → who is đúng. Nhưng 'teaching staff are' cũng đúng (collective có thể số nhiều).
items.ielts_tip: Collective nouns (staff/team/committee): chọn số ít hoặc số nhiều rồi giữ NHẤT QUÁN xuyên suốt câu.

items.stem: Câu mở bài Task 2 nào thể hiện Grammatical Range CAO NHẤT?
options: Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning becomes increasingly popular.
Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
Education is playing a crucial role in society, and online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning has become increasingly popular.
items.correct_answer: Education plays a crucial role in society, and online learning is becoming increasingly popular.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 plays (sự thật ổn định) + is becoming (xu hướng) = Grammatical Range band 6.5+!
items.feedback_wrong: Kết hợp Simple (sự thật) + Continuous (xu hướng) trong 1 câu = đỉnh cao Grammatical Range Task 2.
items.explanation_short: plays (sự thật) + is becoming (xu hướng đang diễn ra) = hai thì khác nhau = Grammatical Range cao.
items.ielts_tip: Task 2 nâng cao: dùng hai thì khác nhau trong 1 câu khi ngữ nghĩa thật sự khác nhau. Không trộn tùy tiện.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'I will present my research findings next week because I have been preparing for months and my supervisor is expecting me to.'
options: I will present my research findings
because I have been preparing for months
my supervisor is expecting me to
Không có lỗi — will và is expecting đều đúng
items.correct_answer: I will present my research findings
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Chuẩn bị từ lâu → kế hoạch đã có → I am presenting (không will present)!
items.feedback_wrong: 'Have been preparing for months' = đã lên kế hoạch từ trước → Present Continuous cho future: I am presenting.
items.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp lâu dài → I am presenting (không will present).
items.ielts_tip: Dấu hiệu kế hoạch có sẵn: have been preparing/already booked/already registered → Continuous. Will = quyết định ngay lúc nói.

items.stem:
Câu Task 2 sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The results are appearing to suggest that blended learning, which is seeming more effective than traditional methods, is gaining wider acceptance.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 appears to suggest (stative) + seems (stative) = cả hai Simple. is gaining (dynamic trend) = Continuous đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: appear (= seem) và seem = luôn stative → Simple. is gaining (xu hướng) = dynamic → Continuous đúng.
items.explanation_short: appear (= seem) + seem = stative → Simple: appears to suggest, seems more effective.
items.ielts_tip: appear to + V (= seem to) = stative → Simple. Nhưng appear on stage (xuất hiện) = dynamic → có thể Continuous.

items.stem: Câu nào CHUẨN NHẤT để trích dẫn nghiên cứu trong IELTS Task 2 body paragraph?
options: Research is consistently finding that students who sleep well are performing significantly better academically.
Research consistently finds that students who sleep well perform significantly better academically.
Research consistently finds that students who sleep well are performing significantly better academically.
Research is consistently finding that students who sleep well perform significantly better academically.
items.correct_answer: Research consistently finds that students who sleep well perform significantly better academically.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Research finds (xác lập) + perform (quy luật) = hai Simple Present. Academic nhất!
items.feedback_wrong: Research finds (sự thật xác lập) + perform (quy luật) = Simple Present. Tránh Continuous cho kết quả nghiên cứu đã xác lập.
items.explanation_short: finds (sự thật nghiên cứu) + perform (kết quả như quy luật) = cả hai Simple.
items.ielts_tip: Academic reporting: 'Research shows/finds/suggests/indicates that + Simple Present' = kết quả như quy luật. Continuous nghe kém academic hơn.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The university is being expanding its online programme, which is being increasingly popular among working adults.'
options: is being expanding its online programme
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ is expanding (không is being expanding) + is becoming popular (không is being popular). 'Being' bị dùng sai cả hai chỗ!
items.feedback_wrong: is expanding (Active Continuous, không cần 'being'). is becoming popular (không 'is being popular' — popular là adj).
items.explanation_short: is being expanding sai (là Continuous Passive không đúng). is being popular sai (popular = adj, không cần being).
items.ielts_tip: Continuous Active: is + V-ing (is expanding). Continuous Passive: is being + V3 (is being expanded). 'Is being popular' không tồn tại.

items.stem: Câu Task 2 nào dùng SONG SONG hai thì đúng nhất về mặt nghĩa?
options: Traditional universities maintain their prestige, but online platforms are disrupting the educational landscape.
Traditional universities are maintaining their prestige, but online platforms are disrupting the educational landscape.
Traditional universities maintain their prestige, but online platforms disrupt the educational landscape.
Traditional universities are maintaining their prestige, but online platforms disrupt the educational landscape.
items.correct_answer: Traditional universities maintain their prestige, but online platforms are disrupting the educational landscape.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 maintain (ổn định bền vững) + are disrupting (đang xảy ra mạnh mẽ) = Grammatical Range cao nhất!
items.feedback_wrong: maintain = sự thật ổn định → Simple. are disrupting = xu hướng tác động mạnh đang diễn ra → Continuous.
items.explanation_short: maintain (sự thật ổn định) + are disrupting (xu hướng đang diễn ra mạnh).
items.ielts_tip: Task 2 đẳng cấp: dùng hai thì có chủ đích dựa trên nghĩa, không phải dùng cùng thì cho 'đối xứng'. Giám khảo nhận ra ngay.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The curriculum, which is containing outdated content, is having a negative impact on students who are possessing strong critical thinking skills.'
options: students who are possessing strong critical thinking skills
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 contains (stative) + is having (dynamic idiom) + possess (stative). Ba động từ, ba quyết định!
items.feedback_wrong: contain = stative → contains. have a negative impact = dynamic → is having đúng. possess (sở hữu) = stative → possess.
items.explanation_short: contain (luôn stative) → contains. possess (stative) → possess. have a negative impact = dynamic → is having đúng.
items.ielts_tip: have = stative khi nghĩa là 'có/sở hữu'. have = dynamic khi trong idiom: have a meeting/impact/look → có thể Continuous.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi?
'I am believing that the number of students who are preferring online education are growing, which is suggesting a fundamental shift in how society is seeing the value of traditional schooling.'
options: 3 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing
4 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing + is suggesting
5 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing + is suggesting + is seeing
items.correct_answer: 4 lỗi: am believing + are preferring + are growing + is suggesting
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! 4 lỗi: believe→believe | prefer→prefer | are growing→is growing | suggesting→suggests. is seeing có thể tranh luận.
items.feedback_wrong: believe (stative) + prefer (stative) + The number of (singular) + suggest (stative reporting verb) = 4 lỗi rõ ràng. 'is seeing' có thể tranh luận.
items.explanation_short: believe/prefer/suggest = stative → Simple. The number of = singular → is growing. seeing (nhận thức) có thể stative nhưng ngữ cảnh cho phép.
items.ielts_tip: Khi review: check stative verbs (believe/prefer/suggest) + The number of (singular) trước. Đây là 4 lỗi phổ biến nhất ở band 5.5→6.5.
